title: 第14章 皇女长跪寝宫外
content_zh:
他打量着拜玉儿，玉容无暇，肌体晶莹，双腿修长，的确不愧为有名的佳人。
特别是其眉心一点朱砂，鲜红如火，非常冶艳。
其中仿佛蕴藏着一团能够焚烧天地的神火。
这拜玉儿的资质倒也不差。
君逍遥本来打算，若此女听话的话，倒是勉强可以当一枚棋子，替他管理朱雀古国。
结果现在看来，又是一个被舔狗舔惯了的高傲美人，自以为天下男人都会围着她转，讨好于她。
“换做其他平民穿越者，说不定就先舔上去了，但可惜，我不是……”君逍遥暗暗摇头。
君逍遥有无敌天赋，无敌身份，无敌背景。
妥妥的一个高富帅。
按理说，应该是别人巴结他才对。
但这拜玉儿，显然智商没有君玲珑那么高。
敢在君逍遥面前装模作样了。
“请问我们认识多长时间了？”君逍遥淡淡一笑，问道。
拜玉儿微微一愣。
怎么突然提不相干的事情了？
但拜玉儿还是说道：“玉儿与公子，乃是初次见面。”
“对一个初次见面的人，这般理所当然的索取不死药，虽然之前答应过你，但我有说过免费送给朱雀古国吗？”
“而且朱雀古国存亡，跟我有什么关系？”
“你父皇的生死，对我很重要吗？”
君逍遥脸上的笑意隐去，语气冷漠道。

拜玉儿这才回过神来，脸色一阵青一阵红。
君逍遥的三问，令她哑口无言，表情尴尬而不自然。
的确，君玲珑只是和她说，有君家天骄愿意给她不死药，却没有说是无偿。
而且朱雀国主和朱雀古国的生死存亡，的确也和君逍遥没有半毛钱关系。
“可公子您并不差不死药，随便送出一株，就可挽救一条生命，乃至亿万生灵，为何不愿意呢？”
拜玉儿依然站在道德的制高点。
君逍遥神色彻底淡漠了下去，冷语道：“很简单，因为不死药是我的，只要我愿意，哪怕给一条狗都可以！”
拜玉儿闻言，娇躯微微发颤，面色苍白，一股羞辱之意从心底涌上。
君逍遥此话，岂不是说在他眼中，她父亲连一条狗都不如？
想到这里，拜玉儿一时心头窝火，忍不住失言道。
“公子何必找借口，不就是对我有意吗，不过很可惜，玉儿已经有未婚夫了，这个条件，恕难从命！”
一语落下，君玲珑玉容瞬间一变。
她没想到，拜玉儿竟会说出这般失言之话。
拜玉儿自己也是回过神来，感觉一股寒气弥漫娇躯内，脸色煞白如纸。
她竟然把心底的话，直接说了出来。
“呵呵……”
君逍遥笑了。
听到他的笑声，拜玉儿心头却更加惶恐。
君逍遥脸上露出玩味，眼神却是漠然。
“你也不照照镜子，本神子有那个必要吗？”

拜玉儿脸色难看至极。
让拜玉儿心头震撼的，是君逍遥的自称。
本神子！
“天啊，难道这位的身份，是君家神子？”
拜玉儿脑海如有五雷轰鸣，心头掀起惊涛骇浪，修长双腿打颤，忍不住瘫倒在了地上。
荒古世家神子，那就是身份地位的绝对象征。
拜玉儿一开始还认为，面前这少年应该是君家一位比较出众的天之骄子。
却不曾想，竟然是一位神子！
“神子大人，请饶恕拜玉儿的失礼！”
拜玉儿跪地，火红长发沾染了尘土都不顾了。
君逍遥脸色始终淡漠。
君逍遥看着跪倒在地，乞求饶恕的拜玉儿，微微摇头。
“付出才有收获，这个连小孩子都懂的道理，看来你并不懂……”
君逍遥冷漠道。
拜玉儿想白白得到一株不死药，未免有些异想天开。
他一甩衣袖，转身即走。
君玲珑则微微定了定神，对拜玉儿叹道：“在神子大人面前这般失礼，我也帮不了你。”
“不，求求你，我父皇还需要不死药救命，他可能撑不了几年了！”拜玉儿哭诉，心头无比后悔。
早知道，还不如本本分分地接受条件。
妄自尊大，害了她。

“早知如此，何必当初。”君玲珑表示爱莫能助。
她不可能为了一个关系浅薄的拜玉儿，去惹君逍遥不快。
“我愿长跪在神子寝宫外，乞求神子的饶恕！”拜玉儿磕头不止，洁白的额头上都是沾染了血迹。
不论是为了朱雀古国，还是为了她父亲和自己，拜玉儿都必须要得到君逍遥的原谅。
君玲珑微微摇头，随她去。
不久后，一些君家人便是看到了，在天帝宫，君逍遥寝宫外，一位红衣美人长跪不起，美颜带着极度的悔意和决然。
“咦，那位好像是朱雀古国皇女，她跪在那干嘛？”
“嘘，好像是得罪了神子大人，我们别搀和。”
所有君家人，对拜玉儿避而远之，当做空气。
天帝宫内，君逍遥躺在一处灵池内放松。
“神子大人……”君玲珑走了进来。
“怎么，想为她求情？”君逍遥淡笑道。
“不是，那是她自作自受，只是玲珑觉得，她背后的朱雀古国，尚有利用价值。”君玲珑思索道。
她怀有七窍玲珑心，心思机敏而聪颖。
“呵，对于她，我自有打算，性格太差，先晾在那里吧。”君逍遥随意道。
虽说他对拜玉儿不喜，但朱雀古国，君逍遥可不想这么放弃。
有拜玉儿当做桥梁，他也能更好地操控朱雀古国。
“神子大人的想法太深了。”君玲珑崇敬道。
纵使她有七窍玲珑心，都猜不透面前之人的想法。
“拜玉儿的未婚夫，嗯，希望他有点自知之明吧……”

拜玉儿，君逍遥是一定要掌控的，因为还有利用价值。
至于她的那位未婚夫，不管有什么身份背景，君逍遥都不在乎。
在荒天仙域，身份背景比他高的年轻一辈，又有几人？
content_en:
He looked at Bai Yu'er. Her face was flawless, her body was crystal clear, and her legs were slender. She was indeed worthy of being a famous beauty.
In particular, there is a little cinnabar between his eyebrows, which is as bright as fire and very beautiful.
It seems to contain a ball of divine fire that can burn heaven and earth.
Bai Yuer's qualifications are not bad at all.
Jun Xiaoyao originally planned that if this woman was obedient, she could barely become a chess piece and manage the ancient Suzaku Kingdom for him.
As a result, now it seems that she is another arrogant beauty who is used to being licked by dogs. She thinks that all men in the world will surround her and please her.
"Other civilian time travelers might have licked it first, but unfortunately, I'm not..." Jun Xiaoyao shook his head secretly.
Jun Xiaoyao has invincible talent, invincible identity, and invincible background.
A truly tall, rich and handsome man.
Logically speaking, others should be the ones fawning over him.
But Bai Yu'er's IQ is obviously not as high as Jun Linglong's.
Dare to pretend in front of Jun Xiaoyao.
"How long have we known each other?" Jun Xiaoyao asked with a faint smile.
Bai Yuer was slightly startled.
Why did you suddenly mention something irrelevant?
But Bai Yu'er still said: "Yu'er and the young master met for the first time."
"It's a matter of course to ask for the elixir from someone you've just met for the first time. Although I promised you before, did I ever say that I would give it to the Ancient Suzaku Country for free?"
"And what does the survival of the ancient Suzaku country have to do with me?"
"Is your father's life or death important to me?"
The smile on Jun Xiaoyao's face disappeared and his tone was cold.
Only then did Bai Yuer come back to her senses, her face turning blue and red.
Jun Xiaoyao's three questions left her speechless and her expression was awkward and unnatural.
Indeed, Jun Linglong only told her that a prodigy from the Jun family was willing to give her the elixir, but she did not say that it would be for free.
Moreover, the life and death of the Lord of the Suzaku Kingdom and the Ancient Suzaku Kingdom really had nothing to do with Jun Xiaoyao.
"But Master, you are not short of the elixir. Just giving one of your plants away can save a life, or even hundreds of millions of living beings. Why wouldn't you want to?"
Bai Yuer still stands on the moral high ground.
Jun Xiaoyao's expression became completely indifferent, and he said coldly: "It's very simple, because the elixir is mine. As long as I am willing, I can even give it to a dog!"
When Bai Yu'er heard this, her delicate body trembled slightly, her face turned pale, and a sense of humiliation welled up from the bottom of her heart.
Doesn't Jun Xiaoyao's words mean that in his eyes, her father is worse than a dog?
Thinking of this, Bai Yu'er felt angry for a moment and couldn't help but made a mistake.
"Young Master, why do you need to make excuses? Don't you just have interest in me? But it's a pity that Yu'er already has a fiancé. I can't accept this condition!"
As soon as the words fell, Jun Linglong's beautiful appearance changed instantly.
She didn't expect that Bai Yu'er would say such gaffes.
Bai Yu'er also came back to her senses, feeling a cold air filling her delicate body, and her face turned as white as paper.
She actually said what was in her heart directly.
"Haha..."
Jun Xiaoyao smiled.
Hearing his laughter, Bai Yuer felt even more frightened.
Jun Xiaoyao's face showed amusement, but his eyes were indifferent.
"You don't even look in the mirror. Is it necessary for me to do that?"
Bai Yuer's face looked extremely ugly.
What shocked Bai Yuer was Jun Xiaoyao's claim.
My son!
"Oh my God, is this person's identity the divine son of the Jun family?"
Bai Yu'er felt like there were five thunders roaring in his mind, and a turbulent wave arose in his heart. His long legs trembled, and he couldn't help but collapse to the ground.
The divine son of an ancient family is an absolute symbol of status.
At first, Bai Yuer thought that the young man in front of her should be an outstanding and favored son of the Jun family.
But I never thought that he was actually a son of God!
"Lord Shenzi, please forgive Bai Yu'er for being rude!"
Bai Yuer knelt down, not caring that her fiery red hair was stained with dust.
Jun Xiaoyao's expression remained indifferent.
Jun Xiaoyao looked at the man who was kneeling on the ground, begging for forgiveness.He bowed to Yu'er and shook his head slightly.
"You get what you pay for. Even children understand this. It seems you don't understand..."
Jun Xiaoyao said indifferently.
Bai Yuer's thought of getting an elixir for free was a bit fanciful.
He flicked his sleeves, turned around and left.
Jun Linglong calmed down slightly and sighed to Bai Yu'er: "You are so rude in front of the Son of God, and I can't help you."
"No, please, my father still needs the elixir to save his life. He may not survive for a few more years!" Bai Yu'er cried, feeling extremely regretful.
If I had known earlier, I might as well have accepted the conditions dutifully.
His arrogance harmed her.
"If I had known this, why did I do it in the first place?" Jun Linglong said she was helpless.
It was impossible for her to make Jun Xiaoyao unhappy for the sake of Bai Yu'er, whom she had a shallow relationship with.
"I would like to kneel outside the Son of God's palace forever and beg for His forgiveness!" Bai Yu'er kept kowtowing, and her white forehead was stained with blood.
Whether it is for the ancient country of Suzaku, or for her father and herself, Bai Yuer must be forgiven by Jun Xiaoyao.
Jun Linglong shook her head slightly and let her go.
Soon after, some members of the Jun family saw a beauty in red kneeling down outside Jun Xiaoyao's palace in the Emperor's Palace. Her beauty showed extreme regret and determination.
"Hey, that one seems to be the princess of the ancient Suzaku Kingdom. Why is she kneeling there?"
"Hush, it seems that I have offended the Son of God, let's not interfere."
All members of the Jun family shunned Bai Yuer as if they were nothing.
In the Emperor's Palace, Jun Xiaoyao was relaxing in a spiritual pool.
"Lord Son of God..." Jun Linglong walked in.
"Why, you want to plead for her?" Jun Xiaoyao said with a smile.
"No, that was her fault. It's just that Linglong felt that the ancient Suzaku country behind her was still valuable." Jun Linglong thought.
She has an exquisite heart with seven orifices, and her mind is alert and intelligent.
"Oh, I have my own plans for her. Her personality is too bad, so let's leave her there for now." Jun Xiaoyao said casually.
Although he was not happy with Bai Yu'er, Jun Xiaoyao didn't want to give up like this in the ancient Zhuque country.
With Bai Yu'er as a bridge, he can better control the ancient country of Suzaku.
"Lord Son of God's thoughts are too deep." Jun Linglong said with admiration.
Even with her exquisite mind, she couldn't guess what the person in front of her was thinking.
"Bai Yu'er's fiancé, well, I hope he has some self-awareness..."
Thanks to Yu'er, Jun Xiaoyao must control it because it still has value.
As for her fiancé, no matter his status or background, Jun Xiaoyao doesn't care.
In the Desolate Heaven and Immortal Realm, how many of the younger generation have higher status and background than him?
